privacy-policy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.html:
Effective Date: July 07, 2025

This Privacy Policy (“Policy”) sets forth the privacy practices of Delphx.com (“Website”) and governs your use of the Website. By accessing or using the Website, you agree to the terms of this Policy.

We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This Policy explains how we collect, use, and disclose your personal data when you use our Website.

Information We Collect

When you use our Website, we may collect the following information:

  • Personal Information: We collect information that can identify you, such as your name and email address, when you leave a comment on our site or request a password reset.
  • Usage Information: We may collect information about your device and how you use our Website, such as your IP address and browser user agent string, to help spam detection.
  • Cookies and Similar Technologies: We use cookies to personalize and improve your experience on our Website. You may set your browser to block cookies or to alert you when cookies are being sent. However, if you do not accept cookies, you may not be able to use some parts of our Website.

How We Use Your Information

We use your personal data for the following purposes:

  • To provide and maintain our Website
  • To personalize and improve your experience on our Website
  • To communicate with you, respond to your inquiries, and provide customer support
  • To comply with our legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements

Sharing Your Information

We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal data to third parties. We may share your personal data with our service providers who assist us in providing our Website. We may also share your personal data if required by law or to protect our rights and interests.

Security

We take reasonable measures to protect your personal data from unauthorized access, alteration, or destruction. However, please note that no method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee the security of your personal data.

Retention of Your Information

We will retain your personal data for as long as necessary to provide our Website and comply with our legal obligations. We may also retain and use your personal data to resolve disputes and enforce our agreements.

Your Rights

You have the right to access, correct, and delete your personal data. You may also have the right to object to or restrict the processing of your personal data. If you would like to exercise any of these rights, please contact us using the information provided below.

Changes to this Policy

We reserve the right to modify this Policy at any time, so please review it frequently. If we make material changes to this Policy, we will notify you by email or by posting a notice on our Website.

Contact Us

If you have any questions or concerns about this Policy, please contact us at info@delphx.com
